name: Sarah Bowles
title: Trainee Clinical Psychologist
bio: Sarah Bowles is a Trainee Clinical Psychologist in the final year of the Doctoral Programme in Clinical Psychology at the Salomons Institute for Applied Psychology, Canterbury Christ Church University. Her doctoral research focuses on how mental health professionals can recognise and support growth following psychosis.

name: Dr Anne Cooke
title: Principal Lecturer and Clinical Director, Salomons Institute
bio: Dr Anne Cooke is Principal Lecturer and Clinical Director of the Doctoral Programme in Clinical Psychology at the Salomons Institute for Applied Psychology, Canterbury Christ Church University. She edited the BPS landmark report Understanding Psychosis and Schizophrenia and was named BPS Practitioner of the Year in 2017.

name: Dr Gerald Jordan
title: Lecturer and Assistant Professor, University of Bristol
bio: Dr Gerald Jordan is Lecturer and Assistant Professor in the School of Psychological Science at the University of Bristol, where he leads the Reach Collective. He received his PhD from McGill University and completed postdoctoral fellowships at Yale and McGill. His research examines post-traumatic growth following first-episode psychosis.
